description: Column mapping table and MH1 alignment block for B. subtilis chemoreceptors against E. coli Tar/Tsr adaptation sites
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, re
ACC = {"Tar_ECOLI":"P07017","Tsr_ECOLI":"P02942","Tar_SALTY":"P02941",
       "McpA_BACSU":"P39214","McpB_BACSU":"P39215","McpC_BACSU":"P54576",
       "TlpA_BACSU":"P39216","TlpB_BACSU":"P39217","TlpC_BACSU":"P39209"}
SEQ={k:"".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=30).text.strip().split("\n")[1:]) for k,a in ACC.items()}
tip={k:re.search(r"G[FLIV][ASG]VVA[DEG]EVR",s).start()+1 for k,s in SEQ.items()}

# Best MH1 registers from the joint offset scan (offset d: Tar pos p -> target p+d)
best_off={"McpB_BACSU":76,"McpA_BACSU":82,"McpC_BACSU":98,"TlpA_BACSU":75,"TlpB_BACSU":75,"TlpC_BACSU":16}
# Alternative register favoured by the single-site Tar Q309 window scan for McpB: d = 371-309 = 62
alt_off={"McpB_BACSU":62}

rows=[]
for tgt,d in best_off.items():
    ts=SEQ[tgt]
    for site,lab in [(295,"Tar Q295 (deamidated, CheB-dependent)"),(302,"Tar E302 (native Glu)"),(309,"Tar Q309 (deamidated, CheB-dependent)")]:
        q=site+d
        rows.append(dict(receptor=tgt.split('_')[0], tar_site=f"{SEQ['Tar_ECOLI'][site-1]}{site}", role=lab,
                         register="primary (joint segment scan)", mapped_pos=q, mapped_res=ts[q-1],
                         is_Gln=(ts[q-1]=='Q'), is_Glu=(ts[q-1]=='E')))
for tgt,d in alt_off.items():
    ts=SEQ[tgt]
    for site in [295,302,309]:
        q=site+d
        rows.append(dict(receptor=tgt.split('_')[0], tar_site=f"{SEQ['Tar_ECOLI'][site-1]}{site}",
                         role="alt register", register="alternative (-2 heptads, single-site window scan)",
                         mapped_pos=q, mapped_res=ts[q-1], is_Gln=(ts[q-1]=='Q'), is_Glu=(ts[q-1]=='E')))
tab=pd.DataFrame(rows); pd.set_option("display.width",250)
print(tab.to_string(index=False))

print("\n--- Gln/Glu inventory in the methylation-helix windows (relative to conserved tip anchor) ---")
inv=[]
for k in SEQ:
    s=SEQ[k]; t=tip[k]
    mh1=range(max(1,t-130), t-70)
    mh2=range(t+60, min(len(s),t+150)+1)
    inv.append(dict(receptor=k, tip=t,
        MH1_Gln=[f"Q{p}" for p in mh1 if s[p-1]=='Q'],
        MH1_Glu_n=sum(1 for p in mh1 if s[p-1]=='E'),
        MH2_Gln=[f"Q{p}" for p in mh2 if s[p-1]=='Q'],
        MH2_Glu_n=sum(1 for p in mh2 if s[p-1]=='E')))
for r in inv:
    print(f"{r['receptor']:<12} tip@{r['tip']:<4} MH1 Gln: {','.join(r['MH1_Gln']) or '-':<28} (nGlu={r['MH1_Glu_n']})   MH2 Gln: {','.join(r['MH2_Gln']) or '-':<28} (nGlu={r['MH2_Glu_n']})")

# --- Alignment block figure: MH1 at the primary register ---
blocks=[]
tar_lo,tar_hi=288,318
blocks.append(("Tar(Ec)", tar_lo, SEQ["Tar_ECOLI"][tar_lo-1:tar_hi], {295:'Q',302:'E',309:'Q'}))
blocks.append(("Tsr(Ec)", tar_lo+2, SEQ["Tsr_ECOLI"][tar_lo+1:tar_hi+2], {297:'Q',304:'E',311:'Q'}))
for tgt,d in [("McpB_BACSU",76),("McpB_BACSU",62),("McpA_BACSU",82),("McpC_BACSU",98),("TlpA_BACSU",75),("TlpB_BACSU",75)]:
    nm=tgt.split('_')[0]+(" (alt reg)" if (tgt=="McpB_BACSU" and d==62) else "")
    blocks.append((nm, tar_lo+d, SEQ[tgt][tar_lo+d-1:tar_hi+d], {}))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,4.0))
cmap={'Q':'#d1495b','E':'#2a9d8f'}
for r,(nm,start,seq,_) in enumerate(blocks):
    ax.text(-1.2,-r,f"{nm} {start}",ha='right',va='center',fontsize=9,family='monospace')
    for c,aa in enumerate(seq):
        col=cmap.get(aa,'none')
        if col!='none':
            ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((c-0.45,-r-0.42),0.9,0.84,color=col,alpha=0.45,lw=0))
        ax.text(c,-r,aa,ha='center',va='center',fontsize=8.5,family='monospace')
# mark the Tar site columns
for site in (295,302,309):
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((site-tar_lo-0.5,-len(blocks)+0.45),1.0,len(blocks),fill=False,ec='k',lw=1.1,ls='--'))
    ax.text(site-tar_lo,0.75,f"Tar {site}",ha='center',fontsize=8,rotation=90,va='bottom')
ax.set_xlim(-14,tar_hi-tar_lo+1); ax.set_ylim(-len(blocks)+0.4,2.6); ax.axis('off')
ax.set_title("Methylation helix 1: B. subtilis chemoreceptors aligned to E. coli Tar/Tsr\n"
             "red = Gln, green = Glu; dashed columns = Tar adaptation sites 295, 302, 309",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
